name: Pinsir
notes: Painted design: brown body (1) with dark painted segment grooves across the belly and two soft darker discs; brown shoulders (13, 20), arms (17, 18, 23, 24), legs (33, 40, one painted groove each) and feet (14, 22); grey pincer horns (47, 54) with a few soft dark dots (painted pores) and a darker inner edge; grey horn spikes, claws and toes (15, 16, 19, 21, 25-32, 41-46, 48-53, 55-60); white teeth (2-6, 8-12); black mouth (7, 34-39).

So: beetle chitin. Body and legs: plates split exactly on the painted grooves (narrow groove, soft bevel, gentle dome per segment), the painted mottling as fine grain, a satin _par. Limbs: grain only, satin. Horns, spikes and claws: smooth hard keratin, painted grain only, a little glossier; the painted pores stay paint (no pits). Teeth and mouth untouched.
Body shader 3116720224 has no normal sampler: in game only _dif and _par load; Body_nor is cache-only.
